name: splicewire/laravel-beam-dev
description: Developer tooling for the Beam family, require-dev and never shipped. Session-scoped scratch databases so concurrent suites stop clobbering each other — created, provisioned from SQL before the first migration, and reaped behind guards that refuse production, the app's own database, and any database another run is still connected to. Plus the wire-name reader that proves a DTO property rename moved no published key.

package-topology.because: beam-dev is family-BLIND by charter: it is developer tooling for the Beam family that must never learn a family type, because every consumer installs it as require-dev and a dependency upward would invert the direction the whole ladder is built on. That blindness is why the load engine takes its work through the LoadTargetSource PORT and ships no implementation of it — the adapter that reads a host's particle registries lives at beam tier, not here. Declared 2026-09-04: this package previously carried NO topology block at all, so a wrong dependency added here would have passed every lint in the estate. NOTE this declaration is currently ADVISORY — it is read by a consumer that merges the installed tree, but this package ships neither rushing/php-package-topology as a dev dependency nor an AssertsDeclaredTopology test of its own, so nothing fails here if it is violated. laravel-beam-market has both and is the pattern to copy; tracked as octane-runtime-substrate ticket 12.
